title: Run profile test vectors
description: Format of test-vectors/run-profiles/cases.json (registry/run-profiles.json, docs/images-and-ownership.md section 5). Each case gives a profile and the options of a `docker run` call, as the argument list between `run` and the image reference, and optionally `after_image`, the arguments that follow the image reference (default: none). expected=conforming: every option group of the profile is present exactly once as consecutive tokens, each placeholder token matching its parameter pattern, every other token belongs to an other_options group and nothing follows the image reference. expected=non_conforming: a group is missing, repeated or altered, another option or an argument after the image is present, or the profile is not defined yet (to_be_defined: no container of that purpose is run).
